lead.en: Before there is a table there is a description of a table. One file lists the routes and the fields; a generator turns the fields into the model the service persists through, and the build proves the two have not drifted.
lead.zh: 有表之前，先有一份表的描述。一个文件列出路由和字段；生成器把字段变成服务用来持久化的模型，而构建会证明两者没有走散。

foot.zh: 第 02 章 / 共 10 章

text.en: `src/spec/greet.api` is the whole description: one `service` block with three routes, one `type` block with two fields. There is no MoonBit in it — it is the shape of the service, not its implementation.
text.zh: `src/spec/greet.api` 就是全部描述：一个 `service` 块带三条路由，一个 `type` 块带两个字段。里面没有一行 MoonBit —— 它是服务的形状，不是实现。

text.en: mctl reads both blocks. The type block becomes a moonorm model; the service block becomes a moonapi scaffold. This repository keeps the model and writes the routes itself, because the routes carry the business logic — the goctl habit of generating the skeleton and filling in the middle.
text.zh: mctl 两个块都读。类型块变成 moonorm 模型，服务块变成 moonapi 脚手架。本仓库留下模型、路由自己写，因为路由里是业务逻辑 —— 也就是 goctl 的习惯：生成骨架，自己填中间。

text.en: `src/gen` is a program rather than a shell script, so the paths live in one place and a failure is a message instead of a missing file.
text.zh: `src/gen` 是一个程序，不是 shell 脚本：路径集中在一处，失败时给出的是一条消息，而不是一个找不到的文件。

out: gen: mctl also produced a 1284-byte moonapi scaffold (routes are hand-written for the business logic)

text.en: The output is committed, and so is what the build expands it into. CI runs the same command, then `moon fmt`, then `git diff --exit-code`, and diffs again after the build: a spec change nobody regenerated is a red build, not a model that quietly describes last week's table.
text.zh: 生成物入库，构建展开出的文件也入库。CI 跑同一条命令，再 `moon fmt`，再 `git diff --exit-code`，构建之后再比一次：改了描述却忘了重新生成，换来的是红的构建，而不是一个还在描述上周那张表的模型。

text.en: Two files. `models.mbt` is the type block as a struct with two annotations, and `migrate.mbt` holds the two migration functions. The build reads the annotations and writes the model into `models.g.mbt`: the table's name, each field with its column type, and a closure that turns a row into the record.
text.zh: 两个文件。`models.mbt` 是类型块变成的结构体，带两个注解；`migrate.mbt` 是两个迁移函数。构建时读这些注解，把模型写进 `models.g.mbt`：表名、每个字段与它的列类型，以及把一行变成记录的闭包。

text.en: The closure that decodes a row is what MoonBit cannot synthesise without reflection. The annotation says what you want and the expansion writes the code out where you can read it, so a decoder bug is a line a test can point at. The second tab is that expansion; moonctl's `generate_model` writes the same shape straight into one file, for a project that wants no build rule.
text.zh: 把一行解码成记录的闭包，正是 MoonBit 在没有反射时无法自动合成的。注解写出你要什么，展开把代码写在看得见的地方，所以解码出错时，测试能指到具体的一行。第二个页签就是展开的结果；不想要构建规则的项目，可以用 moonctl 的 `generate_model` 把同样的形状直接写进一个文件。

text.en: The handler reads through the generated model, so this code is on the request path and not in the tree for show.
text.zh: 处理函数通过生成的模型读取，所以这段代码在请求路径上，不是摆在树里看的。

text.en: The `SELECT` it issues lists the columns the model declares, so a column the model does not know cannot be read by accident. A column added to the type block reaches the query after one regeneration.
text.zh: 它发出的 `SELECT` 只列模型声明过的列，所以模型不认识的列不会被误读。类型块里加一个字段，重新生成一次就到达这条查询。

items.en: Add `email : string` to the type block, run `moon run src/gen`, then build. The diff touches the struct, and after the build the expanded model: two files you did not type.
items.zh: 给类型块加 `email : string`，跑 `moon run src/gen`，再构建。diff 会动到结构体，构建之后还有展开出的模型：两个文件你都没亲手写。

items.en: Run the tests without touching the handler. They still pass, because nothing reads `email` yet. Add it to `user_json` and one test tells you the response shape moved.
items.zh: 先不动处理函数，跑测试。它照样过，因为还没有人读 `email`。把它加进 `user_json`，会有一条测试告诉你响应形状变了。

items.en: Edit `src/genmodel/models.g.mbt` by hand and build. Your edit is gone. The first line of the file said it would be.
items.zh: 手改 `src/genmodel/models.g.mbt`，然后构建。改动没了，文件第一行早就这么写了。

items.en: Read a `.api` spec and say which block becomes which file.
items.zh: 读懂一份 `.api` 描述，说出哪个块变成哪个文件。

items.en: Regenerate the model, and explain why the generated file is committed rather than ignored.
items.zh: 重新生成模型，并解释生成的代码为什么入库而不是被忽略。

items.en: Point at the exact line where a request reaches the generated decoder.
items.zh: 指出请求进入生成解码器的那一行。

items.en: Add a field and predict every file the regeneration will touch.
items.zh: 加一个字段，预判重新生成会动到哪些文件。
